videos.description: PJM Interconnection LLC said its auction to procure power for the year starting June 2028 fell 6.8 gigawatts short of what it will need to guarantee system reliability during demand spikes, according to a statement. videos.title: Sotheby's Sees Very Strong Performance Across Businesses
videos.description: Sotheby's Chief Executive Officer Charles Stewart says demand for luxury items has been very strong. He says a highlight was the sale of a Tyrannosaurus Rex skeleton named Gus that went for $50.1 million on Tuesday. Bidding lasted about 10 minutes. videos.title: Kalshi Ramps Up Effort to Build Markets for AI Computing Power
videos.description: Kalshi Inc. has created a tool that plots the future price of computing power, joining the ranks of exchange and index operators attempting to build markets around the commodity powering artificial intelligence.
